visual.general_description: Grayscale axial CT slice through the upper abdomen with a yellow arrow annotation.
visual.detailed_description: Single unlettered grayscale axial CT image of the upper abdomen, shown with the patient anterior at the top. The vertebral body, both kidneys, a homogeneous liver on the image left, the stomach or bowel with mottled gas and the pancreatic region are seen, and the subcutaneous fat and abdominal wall surround them. A single yellow arrow in the upper left part of the image points toward the margin of a rounded fluid-density structure in the right upper abdomen, adjacent to the liver edge. The caption identifies the arrowed finding as the gall bladder with wall thickening. No panel letters, text labels, scale bars, measurement values, patient identifiers, dates or scanner text are visible. Whether the image is contrast-enhanced and its left-right orientation marker are not printed on the image.
